title: A Quick Café Conversation
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: Two customers discuss a drink order and a food preference.

transcript.text: Sorry, my soup contains cream. Could I change it for a vegetable sandwich?
Of course. It comes with cheese. Should I leave that off?
Yes. I am avoiding dairy, but I will keep the salad.
No problem. A fresh one may take a few minutes.

questions.prompt: Why does the first customer change the order?
options: The soup contains an ingredient they are avoiding today.
The sandwich is the only meal still available.
They have already eaten the soup.
questions.explanation: They notice that the soup contains cream and say they are avoiding dairy today.

questions.prompt: What does the second customer check about the sandwich?
options: Whether it can be served without cheese
Whether it is ready to take away
questions.explanation: The customer points out that the sandwich normally includes cheese and asks if it should be left off.

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about the delay?
options: The café has run out of vegetables.
The replacement is being prepared from scratch.
The customer must pay for a second meal.
The kitchen is about to close.
questions.explanation: The server says it will take a few minutes because they need to “make a fresh one.”
